description: This file contains LESS mixins used for generating grid classes in Bootstrap framework, including functions for creating grid columns with specific widths, offsets, pushes, pulls, and floating effects across various screen sizes.

methods.name: .make-grid
methods.description: Generates grid classes for a specific class prefix, including width, push, pull, and offset variations.

methods.name: .float-grid-columns
methods.description: Creates floating grid column styles for a specified class prefix.

methods.name: .calc-grid-column
methods.description: Calculates individual grid column styles for width, push, pull, or offset based on index, class prefix, and type.

methods.name: .loop-grid-columns
methods.description: Iterates over grid column indices to apply styles for each grid size (from max down to 1).
